title.narrative: Citizen Security Integrated Management Program
Programa de Gestion Integrada De Seguridad Ciudadana

description.narrative: El objetivo general del presente Programa es contribuir a la disminucin de los ndices delictivos de mayor connotacin social en el Paraguay, a travs de una estrategia focalizada de intervencin que combine acciones tanto de control como de prevencin social de la violencia.

The overall objective of this program is contributing to the decline in crime rates of major social connotation in Paraguay, through targeted intervention strategy that combines both control and prevention of social violence.
